names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Димитрий (Чистосердов), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Димитрия пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров (1918).»

attestations.note: The day’s seventh entry, a line of two men; THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS. The line says «пресвитеров» and the name page «протоиерей», archpriest, which is the same order in a higher grade, so `presbyter` with the office `Archpriest` is what the two together say. A Cyrillic grep for «Чистосердов» over every `saint.json` in the corpus returns nothing, `ls -d saints/demetrius-chistoserd*` nothing of this man, and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page carries no troparion and no kontakion under this name; the three it prints belong to the day’s own feasts and to one of its icons.
